purpose: Live-research targets for the Mall@Reds tenant directory, store metadata, and map/floor-plan sources. Research targets only — nothing fetched, scraped, or ingested. All external facts require live verification.

mall_identity_from_repo.name: Mall@Reds

coordinates_from_repo.note: The Reeds, Centurion, Gauteng — from google-dev-agent/.env.example (not independently verified)

mall_identity_from_repo.official_site_referenced: mallatreds.co.za (cited in docs/MALL_RESEARCH_BATCH_WORKFLOW.md; not verified live)

ingestion_destinations.directory: existing store/shops model + retail intake staging (review before publish)
ingestion_destinations.map: mall_nodes / mall_edges graph (migration 005) via the Map Factory pipeline (migration 019) — human-reviewed publish; source column provenance (migration 021)
ingestion_destinations.note: Do NOT write directly to mall_nodes/mall_edges; route through Map Factory staging + review.

directory_targets.discovery_query: mallatreds.co.za/stores OR Mall@Reds official store directory
directory_targets.evidence_needed: official page listing every tenant with shop number + floor
directory_targets.confidence_method: official-source primary; cross-check against Google Places
directory_targets.copyright_licensing: directory facts are low-risk; verbatim copy of styled content is not — extract facts only
directory_targets.priority: critical — unblocks the true tenant list and every retailer identity gap

directory_targets.discovery_query: Mall@Reds management office contact phone email
directory_targets.evidence_needed: official contact for directory/map confirmation + tenant phone verification
directory_targets.priority: high — enables the manual_controlled_uploads evidence lane (phone verification)

directory_targets.discovery_query: Google Places API: businesses at lat -25.8537 lng 28.1878 (Mall@Reds)
directory_targets.evidence_needed: Places records for tenants (name, address, hours, phone, lat/lng)
directory_targets.confidence_method: Places is authoritative for hours/phone; cross-check tenancy vs official directory
directory_targets.copyright_licensing: Google Places ToS — respect usage/caching terms; requires API key + billing review
directory_targets.priority: high — best source for trading hours + phone + geolocation

directory_targets.evidence_needed: prior tenant lists to detect churn / fill gaps
current tenant signals, new-store announcements, promo timing

map_targets.discovery_query: Mall@Reds floor plan / centre map PDF
map_targets.evidence_needed: official floor plan showing store positions per floor
map_targets.copyright_licensing: floor-plan artwork is COPYRIGHTED — obtain permission or derive our own node graph from factual positions rather than copying artwork
map_targets.ingestion_destination: Map Factory extraction → mall_nodes/mall_edges staging → review

map_targets.discovery_query: Mall@Reds centre map image; on-site directory board photos
map_targets.evidence_needed: any accurate positional reference to build the node graph
map_targets.copyright_licensing: copyright applies to images; extract factual layout, don't redistribute artwork

map_targets.priority: critical (routing links every store to a node)

map_targets.discovery_query: Mall@Reds entrances, parking, lifts, escalators, stairs, accessible routes
map_targets.evidence_needed: positions of entrances / vertical transitions / parking / accessible paths
map_targets.priority: high (fixes the audit finding that special node types are unrendered/absent)

map_targets.discovery_query: Mall@Reds leasing brochure OR property listing floor plan
map_targets.copyright_licensing: permission for any artwork reuse; facts-only otherwise

summary.copyright_principle: Extract FACTS (tenant names, shop numbers, positions, hours). Do NOT copy or redistribute copyrighted floor-plan artwork or styled directory content; derive our own node graph from factual positions.
